raw:
“I remember slipping on the basement stairs. There was a loose tread beneath one heel, and suddenly I didn’t feel steady. I caught the rail with one hand. That’s the part I remember most clearly—the feeling that I might fall and reaching for something to hold on to.

For that moment, there wasn’t much else on my mind except keeping my balance. It happened so quickly, but it frightened me. I can tell it quite simply now, but at the time, feeling the stair shift under my foot was enough to really scare me.”
